notes: Agent-harness verdicts (waired-ai/waired-agent#322): can this model actually drive a coding agent's tool-call format? Measured by internal/agentgrade against the real gateway, never asserted from reputation, generation, or context-window size — the model that started this (qwen2.5-coder-14b) advertised tool_use, shipped the standard Hermes template, and belonged to a well-regarded coder series. Every entry carries the engine and version it was measured on, the fixture revision it was measured at, and the date, because compliance is a property of (model, quantisation, engine, harness) and not of the weights alone. Verdicts from different fixture_revision values were measured against different request weights and are NOT comparable. Re-measure with: make e2e-agentgrade MODEL=<ollama tag>
